summary: A glass curtain-wall office skyscraper on a granite plaza: a 26 m square tower with 5 m radius rounded corner… joints revolving_door, side_door_l, side_door_r; options glass_tint.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.skyscraper_glass or place "prefab": "skyscraper_glass" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
